gameDescriptionHtml:
Trials of Innocence is an indie courtroom detective game. Step into the shoes of the main character, rookie lawyer Luna Ray, and navigate her journey through the legal world. Unravel a shocking conspiracy that changes the fate of many, including herself, and confront her inner choices.

The game adopts an anime-inspired art style iterated on the basis of the original artwork. Characters are animated using frame-by-frame techniques instead of keyframe animation, making their movements more fluid and expressive while staying true to the original style. We hope you enjoy our art style!

Game Features

  • In a modern, fictional courtroom, players will defend clients, delve into mysteries, uncover the truth behind murder cases, and exonerate their clients.
  • Play as rookie lawyer Luna Ray or seasoned attorney Charlie Drake, exploring and cracking cases occurring in various unique locations: Chinese-style Haunted House; Serene Mountain Village; High-Tech Research Center; Mine Park; World Games Venue; Skyscraper.
  • With a script exceeding 500,000 words, the game offers a deeply immersive and satisfying experience.
  • Over 100 unique dialogues can be triggered by showing the lawyer’s license! “Anyway, just present the lawyer’s license!”
  • Gather information through testimonies in court and gradually uncover the truth!
  • Use evidence to expose the lies of witnesses!
  • Beyond traditional trials, there are several other exciting gameplay elements: *Special Performance: Brainstorm! When you’re at a dead end, review all known facts. The key clue might already be within your grasp! *Special Mode: Confrontation! Engage in direct confrontations with the prosecutor. It’s thrilling to debunk the prosecutor in one go, but it’s also fun to see the imaginative wrong answers! *Special Mode: Mind Link! Connect keywords related to the case to piece together the truth.
  • Nearly 50 fully remixed original tracks!
  • Engaging sound effects.
  • Voice acting in Chinese, Japanese, and English.
